newsitem.title: USA: CSCE elects board members at annual meeting.
newsitem.headline: CSCE elects board members at annual meeting.

text.p: The Coffee, Sugar and Cocoa Exchange Inc (CSCE) said Tuesday it elected several new members at its annual meeting to serve on the CSCE Board of Managers.

Additionally, CSCE said the election of the Chairman of the Board will be postponed until May, after the candidate for chairman withdrew his name from consideration. Brian Kelly will remain Chairman of the Board until the election is held, the CSCE added.
Adolph Reinhardt, of Reinhardt and Merz Inc, was elected to serve as Vice Chairman of the Board and Willard Hay of Nestle USA was re-elected to serve as tresurer.
New board members elected to two-year terms were Patrick O'Shea of Dean Witter Reynolds Inc and Daniel Rosenblum of E.D.& F. Man.
Board members re-elected to two-year terms were Charles Falk of Louis Dreyfus Corp, Michael Nugent of Merrill Lynch Futures Inc, and R. Noel Smith of General Cocoa Co.

CSCE board members F. Conlin Bradley, Andreas Enderlin, Richard Esposito, Alfred Mascia, William Shaughnessy and Jan-Willem van den Dorpel will remain in office to serve the second year of their two-year terms.
